acceptedByOperator: 2026-11-01: S1-S6 accepted in full; implement and verify on the same Vision VM; preserve data and VDP/Brake/Tire; SSD builds; no CARLA/Main Factory rebuild; no routine prompts

exchange.owner: Internal nonroot adapter in Camera Access OEM package, not another application or lifecycle owner
exchange.framing: 4-byte unsigned network-order length followed by duplicate-free strict UTF-8 JSON; no nonfinite constants, trailing data or extra fields
exchange.producerAuthority: Native resource projection/group plus kernel DAC/SELinux and actual nonroot peer, never a claimed JSON role or credential issued by the broker

gateway.listener: Existing enrolled Gateway TLS listener; selected Vision profile only; no new listening port

context.match: Exact physical world frame and original sample time; absent is unavailable; no interpolation or nearest-frame substitution

gateway.identity: Only the existing selected Vision Unit/node Source-owned identity with explicit context/result scopes; wrong roles/generation and detached clients denied
gateway.credentialConsumer: Separate narrow OEM exchange adapter domain/systemd credential projection only; no app or Camera core key, CA/store creation or Main credential copying
gateway.browserProjection: Opaque references and bounded status only; full Unit/node/source/certificate IDs stay server-side

common.autoSteerConfidence: Raw finite upstream h_vector height/mask, not a 0..1 probability; preserve upstream >=0.5 threshold, no sigmoid or clamp

context.missing: available=false with nullable values, never zero/default/fabricated timestamp

gatewayContext.localProjection: OEM adapter adds only the Camera componentEpoch from Source-owned native selection, never from an application. All remaining binding/frame facts must match authenticated Gateway context.

calibration.acceptedByOperator: 2026-11-01: exact Source-derived camera calibration through existing Perception publish status and Assessment context-read; no new port/resource/app key/control
calibration.profileIdentity: SHA-256 of complete strict UTF-8 document, never mount name only
calibration.perception: Capture-bound status only on perception-publish, two exact frame mappings and no dynamics; unavailable with null profile/maps
calibration.assessment: Same profile and current-frame resizedToVehicle in context-read, matching upstream H_resized=H_raw*inverse(top-crop/resize); never substitute the AutoDrive training-view V; no application file/config/key input

temporal.fusionDelta: Actual positive simulation-time difference between processed current frames, not the 80-120 ms input-pair interval
temporal.plannerCycleDelta: Actual inter-result elapsed time; do not reuse the upstream global horizon step
temporal.firstAfterReset: WARMING with no valid temporal estimates or plan
temporal.noTarget: present=false, distance/speed nullable; upstream 150-m sentinel is not a detected object

delivery.nativeQuotaRule: Measure actual closure and node DMIPS mapping, freeze before publication; no VM increase or unmeasured capacity claim
delivery.unknownMutation: Reconcile authoritative intent/result, never blind replay

excluded: application TLS key or network access
fabricated valid estimates or qualified model accuracy
